fraction_basis: Normalized over the two modeled crystalline phases; amorphous or unidentified material is not included.

unresolved_components.description: No third crystalline phase passed the multi-peak atomistic-support test. A fixed-cell Mn2O3 trial refined to about 0.011 conditional weight fraction, but its fit credit was dominated by one residual/overlaps and it predicted strong unsupported peaks; its presence and fraction are therefore not reliable.
